caseNameFull: Superior Court of the District of Columbia v. Palmore and Swain, Reformatory Superintendent v. Pressley

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. [Certiorari granted, 424 U. S. 907.] Motion of the Solicitor General to vacate and remand judgment in Superior Court of the District of Columbia v. Palmore granted and cause remanded for further consideration in light of Stone v. Powell, 428 U. S. 465 (1976). Remainder of case shall remain on docket of this Court and is now captioned Swain, Reformatory Superintendent v. Pressley.
